variant_answers.text: A leftover maintainer note in the FIX constant, not addressed to the implementer; it places no obligation on the response, and only the function body has to be written.
This only describes the typical use. vowels_count must accept any string and still return the number of vowels in it, including 0 for the empty string.
The string may contain several words (for example a phrase), and the function still applies to the whole string.
The number of distinct vowel letters that appear (for example "aa" gives 1).
Accented Latin-1 forms of these letters (for example 'é', 'à', 'ü') are vowels too.

variant_answers.phrase: at the end of the given word
variant_answers.text: If s contains several words, a y that is the last letter of any word in s is a vowel.
